fusions.name: Lash of the Traces
fusions.desc: Lashes a trace chain into the first enemy in its path for 7 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Slipped the Picket
fusions.desc: You lunge up to 6 tiles to the target, strike it for 13 damage and make it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. The trailing chain leaves it 25% slower for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Dragged to Heel
fusions.desc: Drags up to 4 enemies within 7 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Strain at the Tether
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: a blow strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 27% of your weapon damage per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
